name: Edge-Radar: Weekly Calibration
description: 30-day calibration report (Brier score, calibration curve, recommendations) saved to reports/Calibration/. Places no orders. Default Sunday 23:00 UTC (7 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

parameters.label: Edge-Radar clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone, e.g. C:\Users\you\edge-radar. Its .venv and .env are used.

author: ai-automation-tools
